symptom: The concurrent warm-context test required both callers to succeed, although one could exhaust all three serialization retries before the winner committed and correctly return cloud_agent_credential_busy.
rule: The CI-red playbook requires separate committed and still-pending COMMIT schedules, exact success or refusal, one stored context identity and each caller's original deadline. An INSERT barrier alone does not determine the retry outcome; never widen production retries to satisfy the fixture.
